purpose: Machine-readable contract for the seven low-cost Scene vertical slices. It does not claim that any case is currently selected or passing.

cases.expectedRoute: author source -> generic compiler -> Program -> GraphExecutor -> effect current -> compositor
cases.firstBreakpoint: Inactive optional texture purpose rejected the whole material before the active Program sampler projection, leaving descriptor 168#effect#169 unified-capability-unavailable.
cases.positiveOracle: The exact genericCompilerArtifact node reaches GPU completion, publication, terminal compositor and next-frame; relative to the paired pre-admission 3024x1964 capture, central-rays ROI x=900..1850/y=380..1250 gains at least 30 mean luminance levels while left-control ROI x=100..800/y=650..1250 changes by less than 1.
cases.negativeOracle: Contract rejection for both exact prepared-source artifacts selects boundedSwift for the same node; it still reaches next-frame and leaves unrelated layers visible.

cases.expectedRoute: typed resource readiness -> variant -> generic Program -> GraphExecutor -> compositor
cases.firstBreakpoint: must be recorded when a fixture is approved
cases.positiveOracle: Present and absent optional texture variants follow their declared combo/default and produce distinct predeclared ROI results.
cases.negativeOracle: Pending, stale, or invalid resource generation cannot bind a fabricated texture or poison unrelated effects.

cases.expectedRoute: graph compiler -> target reservation -> ordered GraphExecutor -> effect current -> compositor
cases.firstBreakpoint: must be recorded when a fixture is approved
cases.positiveOracle: Pass order, target identity, extent, publication, and final ROI match the approved contract.
cases.negativeOracle: A middle-pass failure rolls back only the effect or dependent suffix and keeps unrelated graph branches.

cases.expectedRoute: command graph -> logical pair transition -> publication -> next-frame history consumer
cases.firstBreakpoint: must be recorded when a fixture is approved
cases.positiveOracle: Exact logical identity/order and the predeclared two-frame visual sequence are preserved.
cases.negativeOracle: Missing history, stale epoch, or illegal swap fails locally without publishing a false current.
cases.failureRadius: history chain or its real dependents

cases.expectedRoute: dependency plan -> provider publication -> named reservation -> consumer Program -> compositor
cases.firstBreakpoint: must be recorded when a fixture is approved
cases.positiveOracle: The consumer uses the exact approved provider identity and the composed ROI reflects the dependency.
cases.negativeOracle: Missing, stale, mismatched, or cyclic publication only disables the dependent consumer subgraph.

cases.expectedRoute: per-scene VM -> typed host bridge -> mutation transaction -> next-frame consumer
cases.firstBreakpoint: must be recorded when a fixture is approved
cases.positiveOracle: The exact event order and typed mutation produce the predeclared next-frame ROI or value.
cases.negativeOracle: Exception, timeout, OOM, stale handle, or invalid target terminates only the script owner.
cases.failureRadius: script owner and mutations that depend on it

cases.expectedRoute: component registry -> ordered operation stream -> instance lifecycle -> renderer -> compositor
cases.firstBreakpoint: must be recorded when a fixture is approved
cases.positiveOracle: The approved spawn/update/render sequence produces the predeclared multi-frame particle envelope.
cases.negativeOracle: Unknown optional component is diagnosed; missing renderer or illegal numeric state disables only the system.
cases.failureRadius: particle system or real child dependency
